tei:div.tei:p: bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/de yang shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs zhes bya ba dang*/ yang mtha' med kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po rgyal sras thogs med bzang po'i dpal gyi rnam par thar pa gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer zhes bya ba nyan po pa btsun pa dpal gyi rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar bcas khag gnyis mkhyen ldan gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu las/ rnam thar snga ma'i brjod bya gtso bo ni dge slong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rgyal sras rin po cher nyid kyi rnam thar dngos su zhus par lan du stsal ba'i gsung las thos pa dang*/ spyan sngar yun ring du bzhugs pa 'ga' re las thos pa'i rnam thar tshur rol mthong ba rnams kyis brjod nus dag rtsom lus tshig lhug yin zhing*/nang don thad rgyal sras chen po thogs med bzang po'i dpal gnas gang du rigs rus gang zhig tu sku 'khrungs tshul/ byis blo'i khraud las mngon pa'i byang sems kyi rang gshis/ sku nar son rjes 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa'i nges 'byung drag pos thar lam gyi dmu thag tshul khrims kyi dri ngad thul ba'i ngur smrig rgyal mtshan zhig la btags nas rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis 'da' ba'i mi tshe zhig gi brgyud rim rnams 'khyog brjod kyi dri mas dben pa'i drang bden gyi ngag gis gleng ba zhig dang*/rnam thar phyi ma'i brjod bya gtso bo ni rgyal sras chen po thogs med bzang po dpal gyi 'khrungs yul dang rigs rus/ yab yum dang*/ bla ma bsten tshul gtsos sku tshe gcig gi ring*/ rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom tshul rnams bla ma gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas rags rim gsungs pa de la gzhi byas/

sems dpa' chen po nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo mkhan chen byang chub rtse mo'i gsung las byung ba rnams dang*/ yun ring zhabs pad bsten pa'i slob ma rnams kyi gsung las byung ba ci rigs/ khyad par du lo sum cu rtsa grangs kyi bar lus dang grib ma'i tshul du zhabs tog bsgrubs pa'i nye gnas zla bzang gis ngag las byung ba rnams dang*/ dam pa nyid kyi mthong thos kyi rnam par thar pa rnams kyi nang nas che long tsam zhig btus te rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che spyad tshul rnams nyid kyi mdzad pas rgyal sras lag len so bdun ma dang sbyar bar dbu pha yul spangs pa'i phyag len bstan pa nas mjug dge ba byang chub tu bsngo bas brtsam bya bstan bcos kyi don le'u bdun gyis bsdus shing*/ de nas le'u gcig gis zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan tshul dang*/ de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel rnams sku gsung thugs kyi rten du gyur tshul bcas gzhung don gtso bo le'u brgyad kyis bstan pa ste/ khong gi mi tshe zhig gi ring la byams sems dang snying rjes sbags pa'i byang sems kyi spyod tshul kyi rnam thar dang*/ nyam thag gi sems can gcig gi don du 'gyur na mnar med kyi me mur dga' zhing spro bas 'jug pa'i byang sems zhig gi phyag len bston pa'i gzhung lugs zhig dang sbyar ba'i mthong thos dkon pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom tshul zhig kyang snyam mo/ /da lan 'dir mkhyen brtse 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di yang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /nged zhib 'jug khang nas ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang legs sgrig byas pa brgyud da lan mkhyen ldan gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul thub byung*/dpe tshogs 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin mkhan mkhan po 'gro 'dul rdo rje dang*/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/

thub bstan nyi ma/ karma bde legs bcas dang*/ rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gan khur ba zla ba dang*/ blo bzang chos 'phel gnyis/ ma dpe mkho 'don mdzad mkhan dpal gyi 'bras spungs chos sdes stsal gnang byung shing*/ zhus dag thad mngon gsal yig nor kha shas bcos pa las deng dus kyi brda dag dang mi mthun pa'i phrad sbyor stangs dang ming tshig dag dpe rnying la khungs bcol nas mang che bar rang sor dang*/ rnam thar phyi ma'i ma dpe'i dbu shog ma tshang bar gang sar btsal 'tshol byas kyang da lan dpe skrun skabs lag son ma byung bar tshag rtags brgyab nas bzhag yod/ mjug tu ngas ma dpe mkhon 'don mdzad mkhan rnams la thugs rje che zhu/ zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas// //
